title: ilex integra var. ellipsoidea
intro: Ilex integra var. ellipsoidea, commonly known as Japanese Holly, is a plant species native to East Asia, known for its unique elliptical leaves and red berries. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may aid in reducing the risk of chronic diseases such as heart disease and cancer. The therapeutic actions of Ilex integra var. ellipsoidea include its ability to modulate the immune system, exhibit antimicrobial activity, and possess hepatoprotective properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
